> **Workflow is not accepting pull requests, including code or documentation changes.** Please use the issue forms for bug reports or feature ideas. See [the contribution policy](https://github.com/ellisjpeg/codex-workflow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

<!-- The checklist below is retained for maintainer work. -->

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Status-derived dry run
- [ ] No credentials, logs, app bundles, proprietary extracted assets, or machine-specific paths
- [ ] Focused regression coverage added or updated

## Live app

- [ ] No live app mutation performed
- [ ] Live mutation was explicitly authorized and the result is documented
